title: Structured handoff feed to ewsr1-fli1-knowledge-graph
context: The sibling ewsr1-fli1-knowledge-graph project can consume the catalog's vetted datasets. This task defines the export contract for a structured handoff feed of gate-passed, adopted datasets so the KG project can import them reliably. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Define the export contract for a structured vetted-dataset handoff feed to the ewsr1-fli1-knowledge-graph project.
acceptanceCriteria: Specifies a structured feed of vetted (gate-passed, adopted) datasets with the fields and format the ewsr1-fli1-knowledge-graph project needs to import.
Defines the export contract (schema, versioning, update cadence) and confirms only gate-passed open-access metadata is exported.
Output licensed CC-BY-4.0; carries the "research metadata only — not medical advice" label; no individual-level data in the feed.
